note: Rewritten from the species description in Chhotani (1997), originally in English; the source describes only the soldier, records alates as unknown, and does not describe workers or nymphs. The 'Other' section is taken from the nomenclatural history in the source. Literature citations, figure numbers and distribution records have been deleted.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head yellowish brown, slightly darker anteriorly; antennae pale yellow; mandibles dark reddish brown; pronotum pale; legs and abdomen greyish white. Head sparsely pilose; anterior part of postmentum with two pairs of setae. Head capsule subrectangular, sides convex behind the antennae; length to mandibular base 1.40 mm; maximum width 1.09 mm, width/length ratio 0.778. Antennae 13-segmented; segment 3 shortest. Clypeus subtrapezoidal. Labrum subpentagonal. Mandibles long, apical half strongly incurved, coarsely serrate (left mandible length 0.94 mm). Postmentum short, rod-shaped, waist strongly incurved (length 0.67 mm, maximum width 0.39 mm, waist width 0.22 mm). Pronotum saddle-shaped; anterior margin with a distinct notch, posterior margin slightly concave (length 0.35 mm, width 0.61 mm).

sections.label: Other
sections.text: Chaudhry et al. (1972) first proposed the name as a nomen nudum, and Akhtar (1974) later described it formally on the basis of soldier specimens.
